scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.dev:auto: node -e "const net=require('net'); const {spawn}=require('child_process'); const host='::'; const start=3000; const end=3010; const tryPort=(p)=>new Promise((res)=>{const s=net.createServer(); s.once('error',()=>res(false)); s.once('listening',()=>s.close(()=>res(true))); s.listen(p,host);}); (async()=>{let port=null; for(let p=start;p<=end;p++){ if(await tryPort(p)){port=p; break;} } if(!port){ console.error('No free port found in range',start,'-',end); process.exit(1);} console.log('Starting dev server on port',port); const child=spawn(process.platform==='win32'?'npx.cmd':'npx',['next','dev','--webpack','-H',host,'-p',String(port)],{stdio:'inherit'}); child.on('exit',code=>process.exit(code??0)); })();"
scripts.start:auto: node -e "const net=require('net'); const {spawn}=require('child_process'); const host='::'; const start=3000; const end=3010; const tryPort=(p)=>new Promise((res)=>{const s=net.createServer(); s.once('error',()=>res(false)); s.once('listening',()=>s.close(()=>res(true))); s.listen(p,host);}); (async()=>{let port=null; for(let p=start;p<=end;p++){ if(await tryPort(p)){port=p; break;} } if(!port){ console.error('No free port found in range',start,'-',end); process.exit(1);} console.log('Starting production server on port',port); const child=spawn(process.platform==='win32'?'npx.cmd':'npx',['next','start','-H',host,'-p',String(port)],{stdio:'inherit'}); child.on('exit',code=>process.exit(code??0)); })();"
